driver) plus a 22-case rejection/validation battery, and repairs the retained
guard's `chain-tip` check to stacked-ancestry semantics (ADR-0383). The actual
native launch path — ledger `dispatchTarget: subagent` → coordinator
`run_subagent`/`subagent_general` — was executed with harmless stub workers on
both legs; the coordinator-returned transcripts validate `VALID`.

**What changed.**

  base ancestry, recorded ci-boundary/1 read, first-eligible row → emit

- `ADR-0383` records the guard extension + driver/transcript evidence model.
